displayTitle: Meet the Heroes and Villains Boxset
synopsis: Get to know your favorite heroes and villains and follow many adventures across the galaxy with this four-book set.Who is Chewbacca? Just how tall is he? Who is R2-D2? Who are his friends? Who is Darth Vader? Why does he wear a mask? What are stormtroopers? How many types are there?Perfect for children who are new to Star Wars and also for young fans of the movies, these four exciting guides answer these questions and many more and teach children fun facts about loyal Wookiee Chewbacca, friendly famous astromech droid R2-D2, Sith Lord Darth Vader, and stormtroopers--including incredible adventures with Han Solo, Princess Leia, C-3PO, and amazing battles with rebels and Jedi heroes Obi-Wan Kenobi and Luke Skywalker!
title: Meet the Heroes and Villains Boxset
